description: Ticket W2A-1. Add the template engine for the harness manifest in src/main/harness-template.ts: placeholder substitution, `{ json }` values, the headless argument order, and the deep merge of env templates. The ACP runner (a later ticket) calls it.

contracts.text:
/**
 * Placeholders allowed in manifest templates. The runner substitutes them in memory only.
 * - `{prompt}` the user prompt (with any handoff block prepended)
 * - `{model}` the job's modelId
 * - `{baseUrl}` the Lemonade URL in the entry's lemonadeBaseUrlStyle (only valid in Lemonade-local fields)
 * - `{mcpUrl}` the vault/memory MCP server URL from VaultBroker.mcpAttachment (only valid in mcp fields)
 * - `{secret:NAME}` resolves through the vault at launch and is never written to disk
 */
export const TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDERS = ['{prompt}', '{model}', '{baseUrl}', '{mcpUrl}'] as const
export type TemplatePlaceholder = (typeof TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDERS)[number]
export type JsonTemplate = string | number | boolean | null | JsonTemplate[] | { [key: string]: JsonTemplate }
/**
 * A template value. A plain string is substituted directly. `{ json }` is substituted inside every string
 * leaf and every object key, then JSON.stringify'd, for CLIs that take JSON in one argument or env var.
 */
export type TemplateValue = string | { json: JsonTemplate }
/**
 * Env vars for the child process. When the same key appears in more than one applied template
 * (env.cloud or env.lemonadeLocal, then mcp.env), `{ json }` objects are deep-merged in that order;
 * any other repeat is a manifest error.
 */
export type EnvTemplate = Record<string, TemplateValue>

steps: Read the contracts in this ticket (the comments in them are the rules), then global-sct/harnesses.json, global-sct/src/shared/harness-manifest.ts (placeholdersIn), and global-sct/tests/harnesses.test.ts.

Create harness-template.ts. Export `interface TemplateVars { prompt: string; model: string; lemonadeUrl: string | null; mcpUrl: string | null; secrets: Record<string, string> }` and `class TemplateError extends Error`.

Export `renderTemplateValue(value: TemplateValue, vars: TemplateVars, baseUrlStyle: HarnessManifestEntry['lemonadeBaseUrlStyle']): string`. A plain string: replace each placeholder with its value. `{ json }`: replace placeholders inside each string leaf and each object key, then return JSON.stringify of the result. `{baseUrl}` is `<lemonadeUrl without a trailing slash>/v1` for style 'openai-v1' and the bare URL for 'root'. `{secret:NAME}` is vars.secrets[NAME].

Throw TemplateError (never return a partial string) when: a placeholder is unknown; `{baseUrl}` is used and lemonadeUrl is null or the style is 'unsupported'; `{mcpUrl}` is used and mcpUrl is null; a secret name is not in vars.secrets. The error message names the placeholder and never contains a secret value.

Export `buildHeadlessArgs(entry: HarnessManifestEntry, vars: TemplateVars, backend: JobBackend): string[]`. Order: headless.argsTemplate, then instruction.args, then lemonadeArgs (only for backend 'amd-lemonade-local'), then mcp.argsTemplate (only when vars.mcpUrl is not null).

Export `buildEnv(entry: HarnessManifestEntry, vars: TemplateVars, backend: JobBackend): Record<string, string>`. Apply env.cloud for 'cloud-api' or env.lemonadeLocal for 'amd-lemonade-local', then mcp.env (only when vars.mcpUrl is not null). When one key is in both applied templates and both values are `{ json }`, deep-merge the two JSON templates in that order (objects merge by key, any other value is replaced by the later one), then render the merged template one time. Any other repeat of a key throws TemplateError.
Substitute into a JSON template before JSON.stringify, so a prompt or secret with quotes, backslashes, or newlines stays one valid JSON string.

Create tests/harness-template.test.ts with one test for each line in tests.must_add. Use the real harnesses.json for the 6-entry table. Use synthetic secret values such as 'LEMON_TREE_SYNTHETIC_SECRET_1'. Work out each expected value by hand.
Run `bun run typecheck:tsc` and `bun run lint` from global-sct/ and correct each error. Commit the two files with one commit.
acceptance_criteria: harness-template.ts imports only types and placeholdersIn; it has no I/O
A render result never contains an unresolved `{...}` placeholder
A TemplateError message never contains a secret value
buildEnv deep-merges two `{ json }` values of one key and rejects any other repeat
The table test covers all 6 manifest entries for both backends where the entry supports the backend
bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run lint, and bun run test pass

must_add: A plain string replaces {prompt} and {model}, and a string with no placeholder is returned as it is
A { json } value replaces placeholders in string leaves and in object keys, keeps numbers, booleans, null, and arrays, and returns valid JSON
A prompt with a double quote, a backslash, and a newline inside a { json } value parses back to the same prompt
{baseUrl} gives '<url>/v1' for style openai-v1 and the bare URL for style root, and a trailing slash of the URL is removed
{baseUrl} with a null lemonadeUrl or with style unsupported throws TemplateError
{secret:NAME} resolves from vars.secrets, and a missing secret throws TemplateError whose message has the name and has no secret value
{mcpUrl} with a null mcpUrl throws TemplateError when it is rendered, and buildHeadlessArgs and buildEnv leave out the mcp parts when mcpUrl is null
buildHeadlessArgs gives the order headless, instruction, lemonadeArgs (lemonade-local only), mcp
buildEnv deep-merges OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT of the opencode entry: the result parses as JSON and has both the model key and the mcp key
buildEnv throws TemplateError when one key repeats and one of the two values is a plain string

For each of the 6 entries in harnesses.json: buildHeadlessArgs for cloud-api contains the prompt one time and no unresolved placeholder, and buildEnv gives string values with no unresolved placeholder

findings: Ready for dispatch through a T3 subagent (decision S4).
